criteria.text: A function named middle exists and accepts a single list of numbers as its argument
middle returns the median of the list it is given
criteria.quote: returns the median of a list

criteria.text: For a list with an odd number of elements, middle returns the middle value of the sorted list, even if the input is unsorted
For a list with an even number of elements, middle returns the conventional median (the mean of the two middle values of the sorted list)
middle does not alter the list passed in (e.g. does not sort it in place)
